Blog titles contain '2024' but it's 2026 — signals stale content
Case study images have category labels as alt text instead of descriptive text

Add canonical tags to every page
Update blog article titles to remove '2024'
Fix image alt text on case study pages

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Valid XML sitemap with lastmod, changefreq, priority
robots.txt properly configured, blocks /sanity
Next.js 16 App Router — excellent SSR/ISR foundation
All internal links resolve without 404s

findings.title: No canonical tags on any page
findings.description: Neither rokyuddin.com nor www.rokyuddin.com has canonical tags. Both domains may resolve, creating duplicate content.
findings.recommendation: Add <link rel='canonical'> to every page. Prefer https://www.rokyuddin.com as canonical.

findings.title: Non-standard Host directive in robots.txt
findings.description: robots.txt uses Host: directive which is Bing-specific and not widely supported.
findings.recommendation: Remove Host: directive. Use proper 301 redirects and canonical tags instead.

findings.title: Sitemap missing /playground page
findings.description: The /playground page exists but is not listed in the sitemap.
findings.recommendation: Add all indexable pages to the sitemap.

findings.title: Stale lastmod dates on blog and case study sitemap entries
findings.description: Blog and case study entries show lastmod of 2026-01-07/08, while homepage shows 2026-08-25.
findings.recommendation: Update lastmod dates when content is actually modified.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Clear personal branding and value proposition
Well-structured case studies with challenge-solution-results format
FAQ section on About page with hiring-focused questions
Strong E-E-A-T signals: real projects, named employers, specific technologies

findings.title: Critically thin blog content — only 3 articles
findings.description: Only 3 blog articles exist, all from Nov 2024. No new content in nearly 2 years.
findings.recommendation: Publish 1-2 quality articles per month targeting long-tail frontend keywords.

findings.title: Blog titles contain outdated year '2024'
findings.description: Titles like 'Modern Web Design Trends Shaping 2024' signal stale content to users and search engines.
findings.recommendation: Update titles to remove year-specific references or update to 2026.

findings.title: Blog articles are thin and generic
findings.description: Each article is ~500-800 words with generic advice. Doesn't demonstrate depth of a 3+ year developer.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite with project-specific examples. Aim for 1500-3000 words per article.

findings.title: Case study metrics lack verification
findings.description: Claims like '95+ Performance Score' and '92% Recommendation Accuracy' have no verifiable sources.
findings.recommendation: Add Lighthouse screenshots or analytics data to back up claims.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Clear H1 on homepage with descriptive subtitle
Consistent navigation across all pages
Good internal linking between case studies, blog, and homepage
Contact information prominent and crawlable

findings.title: Meta titles and descriptions need verification
findings.description: Unable to fully verify SSR meta tags from fetch. Each page needs unique title and description.
findings.recommendation: Verify in browser DevTools. Use format: 'Md Rokyuddin | Frontend Developer — React, Next.js & TypeScript'

findings.title: Open Graph and Twitter Card meta tags may be missing
findings.description: Portfolio sites rely on social sharing. OG/Twitter tags need verification.
findings.recommendation: Add og:title, og:description, og:image, twitter:card to every page via Next.js metadata API.

findings.title: Homepage H1 is just a name, not keyword-rich
findings.description: H1 is 'Md Rokyuddin' — a name, not a descriptive heading.
findings.recommendation: Consider 'Md Rokyuddin — Frontend Developer' as the H1.

findings.title: Case study titles lack context
findings.description: Titles are just project names ('AltSEO', 'Rydr') without descriptive context.
findings.recommendation: Use: 'AltSEO — AI-Powered Alt Text Generator Case Study'

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: llms.txt file present and well-structured

findings.title: No JSON-LD structured data on any page
findings.description: Zero structured data detected. No Person, WebSite, BlogPosting, or CreativeWork schemas.
findings.recommendation: Add Person schema to homepage, BlogPosting to articles, CreativeWork to case studies.

findings.title: No Person schema for entity association
findings.description: Google cannot reliably associate the site with Md Rokyuddin as an entity.
findings.recommendation: Add Person schema with name, jobTitle, url, sameAs (GitHub, LinkedIn), knowsAbout.

findings.title: No breadcrumb navigation or schema
findings.description: No breadcrumbs detected on case studies or blog posts.
findings.recommendation: Add BreadcrumbList schema with corresponding visual breadcrumbs.

categories.name: Performance
what_works: Next.js 16 with App Router — strong SSR/ISR foundation
Image optimization via next/image with Sanity CDN
Tailwind CSS 4 with CSS variables — efficient styling
Cache Components with tag-based revalidation

findings.title: Unable to obtain real CWV data
findings.description: PageSpeed Insights API quota exceeded. Lab-only estimates available.
findings.recommendation: Run PageSpeed Insights manually. Target: 90+ mobile, 95+ desktop.

findings.title: Framer Motion bundle size
findings.description: Framer Motion (~40KB gzipped) may be overkill for simple animations.
findings.recommendation: Audit motion usage. Replace simple animations with CSS where possible.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: llms.txt file present — ahead of most portfolio sites
Well-structured: author info, key pages, contact, technology stack
Server-rendered (Next.js SSR) — easily crawlable by LLMs
GitHub profile links back to portfolio

findings.title: llms.txt missing blog summaries and case study results
findings.description: AI systems use blog summaries and project results to generate citations.
findings.recommendation: Add blog section with one-line summaries and case study section with results.

findings.title: No llms-full.txt extended document
findings.description: Some AI crawlers look for an extended llms-full.txt document.
findings.recommendation: Create llms-full.txt with full content summaries and detailed project descriptions.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Next.js Image component for optimization
Sanity CDN for image delivery
Remote patterns properly configured in next.config.ts

findings.title: Case study images have non-descriptive alt text
findings.description: Alt text is category labels ('Image Alt text generator', 'HealthTech & Personalization') instead of descriptive text.
findings.recommendation: Use descriptive alt text: 'AltSEO platform screenshot showing AI-generated alt text results'

findings.title: OG/social images need verification
findings.description: Portfolio sites benefit from shareable preview images. Custom OG images may be missing.
findings.recommendation: Create page-specific OG images for homepage, blog articles, and case studies.

findings.title: Sanity image sizing needs verification
findings.description: Images served via cdn.sanity.io may not be properly sized.
findings.recommendation: Verify Sanity image pipeline uses auto=format and appropriate dimensions.
